audit.why: QSS explicitly removes suppression; Malzahar R is the textbook case. R CD 140/110/80, Q CD 6, Taliyah W 14 at rank 1 from the kits.

edits.before: - Malzahar Nether Grasp: matchup-defining — Point-and-click suppression — never step up solo while his passive shield is intact and R is up. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget W Seismic Shove for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: Nether Grasp is 140s at rank 1, 80s at rank 3 — once he suppresses anyone you own a minute-plus window to bully and force plays. His Q silence runs a 6s cooldown and a silenced Taliyah cannot W away, so step up right after his portals miss, and budget your 14s W for his commit, never for poke.
